svg.title: Pixel-art portfolio scene and technology stack
svg.desc: Original pixel art: a developer in headphones codes at a retro monitor beside a cozy cottage on a lavender night with stars and fireflies, with a cat by the stool. Technologies: Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, SQL; Frontend: React, Next.js, Vite; Backend: Node.js, FastAPI; Data Engineering: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Pandas, NumPy, DuckDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL; Cloud: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Vercel; Developer Tools & AI: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Playwright, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, Antigravity.
